svg.text: Five cars, one corner — with the controller off, then on
Same driver, same corner, same aggression (grip_use held fixed, not each car's own limit). Left: an open differential. Right: torque vectoring. Nothing else changes.
[MEASURED] double-track model, closed-loop driver, long_exit, grip_use held fixed at 0.65, 2x power - RUNG 2 — ordering and direction only, not a real car (rule 15)
Every path is simulation output, not drawn. A line that stops and ends in a red dot is a car that left the road.
